title: chiphuyen/aie-book: Practical resources for building AI applications
friendlyTitle: AI Engineering resources for people who build with models
summary: This repository collects chapter summaries, case studies, references and supporting material for Chip Huyen’s AI Engineering book. It focuses on building applications with foundation models and had about 16,800 GitHub stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: Chip Huyen’s repository shares summaries, examples and reading material about building useful AI products. It had about 16,800 stars on GitHub.
whyItMatters: AI engineers can use the repository as a structured reading list and quick reference for model adaptation, evaluation, inference and application design. Much of the material is useful independently, although the repository is designed to complement the book rather than replace it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a learning guide or quick reference for choosing, testing and running AI models. Some sections make more sense with the full book.
